AboutUniversity.desc1: Cairo University was established in 1908 to be the first modern Egyptian university, and today it has become one of the most prominent universities in the Arab and African world.
AboutUniversity.desc2: The university includes more than 25 faculties and institutes, graduating thousands of students annually who hold leadership positions in various fields.

WhyChooseUs.subtitle: We offer a unique educational experience that combines academic authenticity with the evolving requirements of the labor market.
WhyChooseUs.feat1_desc: Official certificates accredited and recognized locally and internationally
WhyChooseUs.feat2_desc: Learn from university professors with over 20 years of experience
WhyChooseUs.feat3_desc: Programs designed to meet modern labor market requirements
WhyChooseUs.feat4_desc: 70% of programs involve practical application on real projects

HowItWorks.subtitle: Four simple and direct steps separate you from developing your career path and obtaining your accredited certificate.
HowItWorks.step1_desc: Browse training programs and choose the path suitable for your goals
HowItWorks.step2_desc: Fill out the registration form and choose the appropriate batch date
HowItWorks.step3_desc: Pay the program fees using the method suitable for you
HowItWorks.step4_desc: Get instant access to the content and start your journey

Certificates.subtitle: Upon successful completion of the program, you will receive an official certificate issued by Cairo University, accredited and capable of being documented by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for work inside and outside Egypt.
Certificates.mockup_desc: The Training Center at Cairo University certifies that the trainee has successfully completed the requirements of the accredited training program.

Testimonials.def_content1: Exceptional educational experience. The scientific content was very accurate and the certificate helped me get a job in a major international school.
Testimonials.def_content2: Great professors and technical support was available at every moment. I highly recommend anyone wanting to develop their educational skills to join these programs.
Testimonials.def_content3: Flexibility in time was the most important feature for me. I was able to balance my job and studies and got an official, trusted accreditation.
Testimonials.def_content4: The program completely changed my career path. An internationally accredited certificate that opened doors I never expected.
Testimonials.def_content5: The content is very strong and the professors are highly experienced. I felt a huge difference in my language and confidence after the program.
Testimonials.def_content6: The diploma was a turning point in my professional life. The balance between theory and practice was perfect.
Testimonials.def_content7: I learned how to manage the training room professionally. The tools I gained are priceless.
Testimonials.def_content8: The practical aspect of the program was amazing. I now work in my own center with full confidence and mastery.

FAQ.a1: Yes, all certificates issued are stamped by Cairo University and accredited by the Supreme Council of Universities, and can also be authenticated by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
FAQ.q2: What are the requirements to join the programs?
FAQ.a2: Requirements vary by program, but generally, professional programs require a higher or intermediate degree depending on the nature of the course.
FAQ.q3: Is there an installment plan for fees?
FAQ.a3: Yes, Cairo University offers easy installment plans for students to help pay tuition fees in batches.
FAQ.a4: Lectures are held in equipped halls on the Cairo University campus, and distance learning (online) options are available for many programs.

comprehensive-counseling.title: Comprehensive Distinguished Psychological Program
comprehensive-counseling.description: Psychological and Family Counseling - Behavior Modification - Psychological Disorders
